prompt:
Title: Invite Your Partner Onboarding
Context: Onboarding partner invitation screen for 'Honey' in the HoneyDo2Done app, designed to feel supportive and welcoming.
Description of the screen: A warm and welcoming invitation screen on a deep charcoal black (#0D0D0D) background. At the top, the header 'Who does your honey-do list go to?' in clean white. Below the header, an abstract illustration of two overlapping soft-glowing circles in honey gold and teal, representing a supportive partnership. Centered on the screen are two sleek text input fields for 'Their name' and 'Their email' with subtle borders and dark gray backgrounds. A prominent 'Send invite' button in warm honey gold (#F5A623) sits below the inputs. At the very bottom, a muted 'Skip for now' link with the helpful subtext 'You can always add someone later'. The layout is spacious, friendly, and focuses on the relief of sharing the load.
Platform: web
Form factor: desktop
